scope: ROS 2 Block, Layer, Mesh and MeshBlock message definitions; fields and constants retain the ROS 1 definitions verbatim.
transport_note: Identical message fields allow a ROS1/ROS2 bridge mapping; DDS/CDR itself is not ROS1 wire serialization.
mesh_protocol_note: Mesh coordinates follow mesh_vis.h rather than its shorthand message comment: uint16 truncation of 65535*0.5*(vertex/block_size-block_index), decoded as (2*encoded/65535+block_index)*block_size. Vertex triples form triangles; missing RGB selects receiver-side normal coloring; empty MeshBlock deletes that block. There is no layer action/reset field in Mesh.
